decisive_items: a well-circumscribed, extra-axial mass posterolateral to the right side of the spinal cord at C7–T1
it demonstrated a thin rim of enhancement with no internal enhancement
response.rationale: Meningioma is more likely due to the description of the mass as well-circumscribed and extra-axial with a thin rim of enhancement, which is consistent with typical imaging characteristics of meningiomas

rejected.why: Schwannoma is less likely due to the lack of specific mention of nerve sheath involvement or characteristic imaging features such as a dumbbell shape
